provenance.line: syslog_to_json, and the assertions in test_rfc5424_with_structured_data
provenance.note: Field for field what syslog_to_json inserts: message, facility, severity, timestamp, hostname, appname, procid, msgid, structured_data, _source. The input line is the one the test uses -- <165>1 2026-03-03T10:30:00.123+11:00 web01 nginx 1234 ID47 [exampleSDID@32473 iut="3" eventSource="Application"] This is a test message.
